purpose: Controlled free-form JSON editor in one frame: validity status and Format float at the top inline-end corner of a lazily loaded CodeMirror view with marked problem lines, backed by a native textarea.
useWhen: Editing arbitrary JSON source while preserving the exact string in parent-owned state.
The value is genuinely free-form JSON and benefits from line numbers, folding, and completion.

avoidWhen.reason: The value has a known shape that a guided form can edit.
Editing a JSON Schema with guided form and diff views.

keyboard.action: Moves focus out of the editor without trapping the keyboard.
Formats the document as indented JSON.
Opens schema completions when a schema is provided.

notes: The editable area is labelled by the visible label and described by the description and parse feedback; a native textarea with the same wiring serves until the editor loads and wherever it cannot.
